defects.defect: No goblins or any enemies advancing from the top; the mages face an empty field, so the screen reads as idle, not battle
defects.direction: Spawn goblin sprites entering from the top of the arena and advancing toward the mages

defects.defect: No goblins/enemies advancing from the top; the battle screen shows only the three mages standing idle with nothing to fight and no damage numbers
defects.direction: Spawn an enemy wave descending from the top of the arena with floating damage numbers so the screen reads as an active battle

defects.defect: Arena is a flat tiled sand texture with only scattered pebble/tuft speckles; no painted props filling the width, no camp ledge, no depth or horizon — reads as an unfinished placeholder field, not a painted environment
defects.direction: Dress the arena with painted props (rocks, banners, tents, fence, foliage) across the full width plus a camp ledge on the right and a horizon/ground-shading gradient

defects.defect: The three mage cards are flush against the screen edges — the left card's outer frame is cropped and the right card's frame is clipped, with no outer margin
defects.direction: Inset the card row with equal left/right margins so each card's gold frame is fully visible
defects.region: HUD cards, left and right edges x≈0-20 and x≈700-725

defects.defect: Sprite scale is inconsistent — the dwarf (center) is markedly larger and higher-detail than the two robed mages, and all three are small relative to the arena, leaving large empty sand
defects.direction: Normalize character sprite heights and increase overall sprite scale so the trio occupies the arena's stage band

defects.defect: Portrait rings contain tiny full-body sprites shrunk to thumbnail size rather than framed portrait busts; Ember's and Sage's portraits are near-identical grey blobs and do not match their arena sprites
defects.direction: Use cropped bust portraits matching each hero's arena sprite, scaled to fill the ring

defects.defect: Hero names overrun their cards — 'Bastion' and 'Ember' overlap/extend past the portrait ring and the card's inner panel edge
defects.direction: Constrain names to the panel width with truncation or smaller type, offset clear of the portrait ring

defects.defect: No goblins or other enemies are advancing from the top.
defects.direction: Add a readable enemy wave entering from the upper arena.

defects.defect: No damage numbers or combat feedback anywhere despite the spec calling for readable damage numbers
defects.direction: Render floating damage numbers over combat targets with outline/contrast against the sand

defects.defect: All three mages sit in a static central cluster; the melee/ranged role staging is unclear.
defects.direction: Stage the two melee mages forward toward enemies and keep the ranged mage visibly positioned at the camp ledge.

defects.defect: Mages sit mid-arena in a loose diagonal with no formation logic; the two melee mages are not advanced toward any enemy line and the ranged mage holds no visible camp ledge
defects.direction: Anchor the ranged mage on a defined camp ledge at the bottom/right and push the two melee mages forward toward the enemy approach lane

defects.defect: A circular element (likely a stage-track node or hero sprite) is clipped by the top edge of the HUD panel, leaving a stray half-shape
defects.direction: Raise the arena content or lower its safe area so nothing intersects the HUD panel edge

defects.defect: A second full resource banner (energy/gold/gems/diamonds) sits above the battle top strip; spec calls for a top strip with only speed chip, level/stage title and pause
defects.direction: Remove or collapse the resource banner during battle so the top strip is speed chip + title + pause only

defects.defect: The title strip is a flat pale beige rectangle with no frame, clashing with the ornate dark-wood/gold framing used by the banner above and HUD below
defects.direction: Restyle the strip with the same carved wood + gold-trim frame language as the rest of the chrome

defects.defect: Full-health HP bars are rendered solid red, reading as critical damage; they also have no frame or fill gradient
defects.direction: Use a green-to-red gradient keyed to HP fraction, framed in the card's gold trim
defects.region: HP bars on all three cards, y≈1340-1360

defects.defect: The sand field is very sparse and lacks the props and camp ledge needed to read as a finished battle environment.
defects.direction: Add varied rocks, ruins, vegetation, and a distinct camp/ledge for the ranged mage.

defects.defect: Arena dressing is only repeated small pebble/grass scatter plus one rock pile bottom-right; no camp ledge for the ranged mage to hold, so the environment reads unfinished
defects.direction: Add larger width-filling props (camp ledge/tents, rock formations, bones, path texture variation) and a visible camp structure near the ranged mage

defects.defect: A tall flat brown band of dead space sits under the HUD cards, letterboxing the bottom of the screen
defects.direction: Extend the HUD frame to the safe-area bottom or reduce the band to a thin trim

defects.defect: The 1x speed chip's ornamental frame is flush against / slightly cut by the left screen edge
defects.direction: Inset the speed chip so its full ornament renders with edge margin matching the pause button's right inset

defects.defect: Partial dark shapes appear clipped at the arena/HUD boundary.
defects.direction: Remove or fully reveal the clipped arena props before the HUD begins.

defects.defect: The two melee mages are not advancing toward enemies; all three stand in a loose static cluster mid-field
defects.direction: Position/animate the two melee mages moving up-field toward the enemy spawn while Sage holds back near the camp

defects.defect: The stage track is a thin bare line with mismatched node styles (diamond, small ring, large ring, plain dot) and runs off the bottom without a terminus or labels
defects.direction: Give the track a consistent framed rail, uniform node art with a distinct current-node highlight, and a defined start/end cap

defects.defect: Gear tiles use plain grey rounded squares with mismatched icon styles and inconsistent icon padding, breaking the gold-frame HUD language
defects.direction: Frame gear tiles in the same gold/wood trim and normalize icon size and padding across all six tiles
defects.region: gear tiles on all HUD cards, y≈1385-1445

defects.defect: A partial brown decorative curve is clipped by the HUD boundary at the arena's bottom edge
defects.direction: Move the prop fully into the arena or cull sprites that intersect the HUD seam

defects.defect: A floating gold-bar pickup sits half-cut by the HUD edge with no shadow or ground contact
defects.direction: Move the pickup fully inside the arena bounds and add a ground shadow
